Name: Bigger Sheds
Author: JessebotX
Description:
Expansion to the [b]interior[/b] of the shed. Comes with [u]8 different versions[/u] with wallpaper and flooring and [b]configurable through config.json[/b][b] ([/b]instructions are given in the config.json[b])

- now downloadable from [url=https://www.moddrop.com/app/]ModDrop[/url] [/b][i](thanks ModScientist)[/i][b]
[/b]
[i][size=2]FOR THE PEOPLE WONDERING HOW BIG THE SHED IS, IF YOU INCLUDE THE EMPTY/WALL TILES, THE [b]SHED IS 32x24[/b] WHICH HAS 768 TILES.[/size][/i]

[u][b]Sheds are now about 4.5 times bigger.

[/b][/u][i]REQUIRES SDV 1.3.32+, SMAPI 2.9+ and CP 1.6+[/i]
[i]
This is my first mod. :D

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/i]
